answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 2 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in pulse, checked in thread, and sparrow publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1072 identities would post 919 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
